blurb: Dance Xplosion provides a variety of dance classes including jazz, ballet, lyrical, tap, musical theatre, modern, hip-hop, and other movement forms. They offer youth classes for ages 18 months to 18 years and adult classes for ages 18 and older. Summer programs include classes, camps, intensives, workshops, and master classes with opportunities to fulfill school dance hour requirements.
